crack_recurrence.title: Cracks in the substrate
crack_recurrence.explanation: Cracks were found in the substrate.
crack_recurrence.consequence: The cracks may show through the new finishing layers.
crack_recurrence.mitigation: Strengthen the substrate with glass fleece or anti-crack mesh on the joints.
crack_recurrence.communication: I will add crack protection so the cracks do not show after the work is finished.

board_movement_crack.title: Cracks on the plasterboard joints
board_movement_crack.explanation: The plasterboard structure moves and there are cracks on the joints.
board_movement_crack.consequence: Further movement of the structure may crack the new layers again.
board_movement_crack.mitigation: Check and stabilise the structure, strengthen the joints with tape and glass fleece, provide expansion joints.
board_movement_crack.communication: After the structure is stabilised I will strengthen the joints so the cracks do not return.

moisture_block_finishing.title: Raised moisture of the substrate
moisture_block_finishing.explanation: The measured moisture exceeds the allowed level for this substrate.
moisture_block_finishing.consequence: Finishing on a damp substrate may peel off, grow mould or fade.
moisture_block_finishing.mitigation: Stop the finishing until the substrate dries, then repeat the moisture measurement.
moisture_block_finishing.communication: I am stopping the work until the substrate has dried — finishing on a damp substrate loses its durability.

weak_adhesion_prep.title: Weak adhesion of the coatings
weak_adhesion_prep.explanation: Weak adhesion of the existing coatings to the substrate was found.
weak_adhesion_prep.consequence: The new layers may not bond firmly; peeling is possible.
weak_adhesion_prep.mitigation: Remove or scrape off the unstable coatings and prime the substrate with a strengthening primer.
weak_adhesion_prep.communication: I will remove the poorly bonded layers and strengthen the substrate with primer before further work.

loose_substrate_removal.title: Loose fragments of the substrate
loose_substrate_removal.explanation: The substrate has loose, crumbling fragments with unreliable load-bearing capacity.
loose_substrate_removal.consequence: On a loose substrate the skim coat and painting will not last.
loose_substrate_removal.mitigation: Remove the loose fragments, repair the damage and prime the substrate.
loose_substrate_removal.communication: The loose fragments of the substrate will be removed so that the new layers have a stable base.

dusty_substrate_prime.title: Dusty substrate
dusty_substrate_prime.explanation: Dust on the substrate weakens the bond.
dusty_substrate_prime.consequence: Dust may reduce the adhesion of the following layers.
dusty_substrate_prime.mitigation: Remove the dust and prime the substrate before starting the work.
dusty_substrate_prime.communication: The surface will be dusted off and primed for good adhesion.

oily_substrate_degrease.title: Oily substrate
oily_substrate_degrease.explanation: Oil or grease stains are visible on the substrate.
oily_substrate_degrease.consequence: Grease reduces adhesion and may cause stains on the new coatings.
oily_substrate_degrease.mitigation: Degrease the substrate, then prime it with a suitable primer.
oily_substrate_degrease.communication: The substrate will be degreased before the work starts.

mold_treatment_before_finish.title: Mould / fungus
mold_treatment_before_finish.explanation: Traces of mould or fungus were found on the substrate.
mold_treatment_before_finish.consequence: The growth of mould may get through the new layers and endanger health.
mold_treatment_before_finish.mitigation: Remove the cause of the dampness, apply a biocide and prepare the substrate against fungus.
mold_treatment_before_finish.communication: Before the finishing we will remove the mould and its cause so the problem does not return.

delamination_repair.title: Flaking / delamination of the substrate
delamination_repair.explanation: There is flaking or delamination of the substrate surface.
delamination_repair.consequence: Flaking causes unevenness and instability of the new layers.
delamination_repair.mitigation: Remove the flaking, repair the damage and strengthen the substrate with primer.
delamination_repair.communication: The flaking of the substrate will be repaired before the work continues.

unevenness_prep_increased.title: Increased unevenness
unevenness_prep_increased.explanation: Deviations from the plane exceed 3 mm.
unevenness_prep_increased.consequence: For higher quality classes, levelling of the whole surface is required.
unevenness_prep_increased.mitigation: Provide levelling skim coating or extra preparation of the substrate.
unevenness_prep_increased.communication: The substrate will be levelled before the next layers are applied.

joint_tape_missing_rework.title: Missing tape on the board joints
joint_tape_missing_rework.explanation: The joints of the plasterboard sheets were not reinforced with tape.
joint_tape_missing_rework.consequence: Joints without tape reinforcement may crack along the edges.
joint_tape_missing_rework.mitigation: Fill the joints with reinforcing tape on all the joints.
joint_tape_missing_rework.communication: The tape reinforcement of the joints will be added so the joints stay stable.

fastener_corrosion_fix.title: Corrosion of fasteners
fastener_corrosion_fix.explanation: Traces of corrosion are visible on the fasteners of the plasterboard structure.
fastener_corrosion_fix.consequence: Corrosion may show through on the surface as stains.
fastener_corrosion_fix.mitigation: Protect the fasteners with a suitable agent so they do not show on the coating.
fastener_corrosion_fix.communication: The fasteners will be protected against corrosion so the stains do not show through on the surface.

joint_gap_filling.title: Gaps on the joints
joint_gap_filling.explanation: The width of the gaps on the joints exceeds 2 mm.
joint_gap_filling.consequence: Wide gaps need filling before skim coating.
joint_gap_filling.mitigation: Fill the gaps with a suitable compound and reinforce them with tape.
joint_gap_filling.communication: The wide gaps will be filled so that the joints stay durable.

efflorescence_cause_check.title: Salt efflorescence
efflorescence_cause_check.explanation: Salt efflorescence is visible on the substrate.
efflorescence_cause_check.consequence: Salts may cause efflorescence again and weaken the adhesion of the coatings.
efflorescence_cause_check.mitigation: Remove the source of moisture, remove the efflorescence mechanically and apply a salt-blocking agent.
efflorescence_cause_check.communication: The efflorescence will be removed and the substrate protected so that it does not return.

blow_holes_filling.title: Blow holes / bubbles
blow_holes_filling.explanation: Small blow holes (bubbles) are visible on the surface.
blow_holes_filling.consequence: Blow holes may be visible under new coatings, especially paint.
blow_holes_filling.mitigation: Fill the blow holes with skim coat and sand before painting.
blow_holes_filling.communication: Small blow holes will be filled before painting so the surface is smooth.

WYSOKOSC_PRACY.name: Working height
WYSOKOSC_PRACY.description:
Adjustment of the labour cost for the real drop in productivity caused by the height at which the work is done.

Use it when the base price assumes work from the floor or a low ladder, and this particular work needs to be done higher up (for example high walls and ceilings, stairwells, mezzanines).

Do not use it if the height is already included in the base price of the line. The cost of scaffolding, platforms or equipment hire is NOT part of this coefficient — account for it separately (a separate line or a surcharge on the order).

STANDARDOWA.name: Standard
STANDARDOWA.description: The height assumed in the base price — work from the floor or a low ladder/platform. No price adjustment. Choosing this option records a conscious decision that the height does not make the work harder.

PODWYZSZONA.name: Raised
PODWYZSZONA.description: Work clearly higher than the base price assumes, with frequent climbing and moving of the ladder or platform, which lowers productivity. Account for the cost of the equipment itself separately.

WYSOKA.name: High
WYSOKA.description: Work at a great height (for example from scaffolding), where productivity drops markedly because of the limited reach and the moving about. The cost of scaffolding or equipment hire is NOT included — account for it separately.

DOSTEP_DO_POWIERZCHNI.name: Access to the surface
DOSTEP_DO_POWIERZCHNI.description:
Adjustment of the labour cost for limited access to the surface that lasts the whole time the work is done.

Use it when you cannot approach freely or work with the tool, for example narrow passages, surfaces behind built-in fittings or installations, work in cramped rooms, fixed furniture or equipment that cannot be removed.

Do not use it for a one-off moving of furniture or equipment — if it is paid, account for it as a separate line. Do not combine it with lines in which the difficult access is already priced.

SWOBODNY.name: Free
SWOBODNY.description: Free access to the whole surface, assumed in the base price. No price adjustment.

UTRUDNIONY.name: Difficult
UTRUDNIONY.description: Access is partly limited the whole time of the work (for example a narrow passage, fixed furniture next to the surface), which noticeably slows the work down.

BARDZO_UTRUDNIONY.name: Very difficult
BARDZO_UTRUDNIONY.description: Access is severely limited the whole time of the work (for example work in a very tight space, behind installations, in an awkward position). It does not apply to a one-off moving of furniture.

ZLOZONOSC_POWIERZCHNI.name: Complexity of the surface
ZLOZONOSC_POWIERZCHNI.description:
Adjustment of the labour cost for the drop in productivity caused by the shape and fragmentation of the surface: many small areas, abutments, edges or frequent changes of the direction of work.

Use it, for example, for surfaces divided into narrow strips, with many bends, slopes, beams or small areas between openings.

Do not use it to price again elements that are already separate price list lines (for example reveals, corners or other separately measured work) — that would be counting twice.

STANDARDOWA.name: Standard
STANDARDOWA.description: A typical, mostly uniform surface, assumed in the base price. No price adjustment.

ZLOZONA.name: Complex
ZLOZONA.description: A surface with many bends, edges or small areas that noticeably slow the work down. It does not apply to elements priced separately (reveals, corners).

BARDZO_ZLOZONA.name: Very complex
BARDZO_ZLOZONA.description: A heavily fragmented surface — small areas, abutments and frequent changes of direction dominate. Do not combine it with separate lines for the same elements.

ORGANIZACJA_PRACY.name: Organisation of the work
ORGANIZACJA_PRACY.description:
Adjustment of the labour cost for the drop in productivity caused by the organisation of the work, not by the surface itself.

Use it, for example, for limited hours of access, work in an occupied or operating building, repeated clearing of zones, or the need to stop and resume the work regularly.

It does not cover extra activities such as protection, moving of equipment or extra cleaning — if they are paid, account for them as separate lines. Night, weekend or urgent work is a surcharge on the order, not this coefficient.

CIAGLA.name: Continuous
CIAGLA.description: Continuous work without organisational limits, assumed in the base price. No price adjustment.

OGRANICZONA.name: Limited
OGRANICZONA.description: Work in limited hours or in an operating / occupied building, which shortens the effective working time.

ETAPOWA.name: In stages / interrupted
ETAPOWA.description: The work is done in stages or is regularly stopped and resumed (for example repeated clearing of zones). Account for protection and cleaning separately.
